name: PT ABM Investama Tbk
summary: PT ABM Investama Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the coal mining business in Indonesia. The company operates through four segments: Mining Contractors and Coal Mining, Services, Manufacturing, and Other. It offers mining contractor and coal mining and trading services, as well as electricity solution, integrated logistics, engineering, and development services. The company also designs and manufactures mining heavy equipment support and material transportation equipment, as well as offers fuel and lubricant products.
